title: Single logo variant captured
body: Only one logo variant captured (inline-svg). The redesign will need a monochrome / inverted variant set; direct should plan that.

title: Multiple palette colors used in only one context
body: These colors appear in a single context only: #f2f0eb (background, background-only); #0c4243 (accent-1, background-only); #ece9e2 (accent-2, background-only). Direct will need to decide: drop, expand, or keep as accent.
